'''Exar Kun Yeah we got a plan (WHAP)''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Exar Kun]]
* '''Published:''' 4 September 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]

* '''Strategy:''' We Have A Plan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PR3 We Have A Plan Kun LS 2002 GPN.txt |Download]]

A We got a plan deck that wont fail (Need a little Input)
